name: Damibwa AP OLD
source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

defensiveAbilities.name: Deep Breath
defensiveAbilities.description: A damibwa can hold its breath for 5 minutes.

defensiveAbilities.name: Echolocation 60 feet
defensiveAbilities.description: A damibwa's hearing is a precise sense at the listed range.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fetch
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The damibwa has a Small or smaller creature grabbed in water

Effect The damibwa attempts an athletics|defense:fortitude check against the creature's Fortitude DC.

Critical Success The damibwa moves up to its swim Speed, dragging the Grabbed creature along with it.

Success The damibwa moves up to half its swim Speed, dragging the grabbed creature along with it.

Failure The damibwa doesn't move and the creature isn't dragged.

Critical Failure The damibwa no longer has the creature grabbed.

offensiveAbilities.name: Predatory Dive
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The damibwa is in or adjacent to water

Effect The damibwa moves up to double its swim Speed, descending at least 10 feet, and then makes a jaws Strike. If it was Undetected at the start of predatory dive, it remains undetected until after the attack.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
